entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I ordered something and I'm just so confused about what to do. I think I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, it's Michael Chen. Order number is... uh... VF88-12-90-11.
Thank you, Michael. I see your order for the Aero Race Jersey. Can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the item?

Oh, it's the jersey, yes. It's... well, I think I just got the wrong size. I tried it on and it's way too tight. I don't understand the sizing charts on the website, they're so complicated. I thought a medium would be fine.
I understand. Our race-fit items can be quite snug. So you'd like to do an exchange for a different size?
Yes, an exchange would be great, but I'm not sure how. I looked online and saw so many different policies, I got overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Michael, that's what I'm here for. Let me just check the policy for your jersey. One moment.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Your purchase is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. We can absolutely process that for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. So it's okay that it's the wrong size and just too tight for me?

Yes, that's perfectly fine. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just package the jersey back up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the larger size for you.
Wow, thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome, Michael. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Have a great day, and enjoy your new jersey when it arrives. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
